hooks.command: for d in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" "$PWD" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"/*/; do [ -f "$d/package.json" ] || continue; [ "$d/package.json" -nt "$d/node_modules/.package-lock.json" ] || continue; if (cd "$d" && npm install --no-audit --no-fund >node_modules/.claude-npm-install.log 2>&1); then touch "$d/node_modules/.package-lock.json"; echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"package.json modifie : npm install termine\"}"; else echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"package.json modifie : npm install a echoue (voir node_modules/.claude-npm-install.log)\"}"; fi; break; done; exit 0
